name: Teleidoscope ML auto-track camera
description: Machine-learning EO/IR auto-track gimbal. The fielded program is the NCR-IADS airspace-warning camera modernization; no source places Teleidoscope in FS-LIDS or M-LIDS, and no source supports a fire-control role. Ranges are planning figures.

rangeAccuracyM.note: Passive imager with no rangefinder documented: bearing only; not established by the public record.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.note: Class median of the sourced classification EO/IR gimbals: lib-hdcmr 0.029, lib-cm262 0.0046; median 0.017 deg.

elevationAccuracyDeg.note: Class median of the sourced classification EO/IR gimbals: lib-hdcmr 0.029, lib-cm262 0.0046; median 0.017 deg.

pixelPitchUm.note: Planning factor: Teleidoscope publishes no camera hardware figures (teleidoscope.com lists software only; the DIU award names 'upgraded EO/IR cameras' without numbers). No sourced classification-role EO/IR in the library publishes a pitch, so the HD MWIR class figure of 10 µm (Lynred Daphnis-HD MW) is used.

focalLengthMm.note: Class median of the sourced classification-role EO/IR gimbals: lib-cm262 300 mm is the only published focal length in the role. A one-member median; recorded as such.

detectorPixelsH.note: Class median of the sourced classification-role EO/IR gimbals: lib-cm262 1280, lib-hdcmr 1280; median 1280.

fovDeg.note: Class median of the sourced classification-role EO/IR gimbals' narrow thermal field: lib-cm262 2.4°, lib-hdcmr 3.0°; median 2.7°.

mrtdMk.note: Planning factor: no MRTD or NETD is published. Cooled MWIR cores publish NETD of 20 mK (Lynred Daphnis-HD MW), <25 mK (Teledyne FLIR Neutrino SX12) and <30 mK (DRS HexaBlu 1280-MW); the 25 mK median is used as the low-spatial-frequency MRTD.
